newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne gets FDA marketing OK for device.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne gets FDA marketing OK for device.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said Tuesday it has received marketing clearance from the United States Food and Drug Administration for its new Tranquility Bilevel product, a device for maintaining airway patency utilizing dual pressures.

Healthdyne said the clearance paves the way for North American introduction of the device in early May. The Tranquility Bilevel was successfully introduced internationally late in the first quarter of 1997.

"We are excited about the potential of our Tranquility Bilevel," stated Craig B. Reynolds, president and chief executive officer of the company. "The Tranquility Bilevel, combined with the Quantum, our non-invasive ventilator, and our Tranquility CPAP product line, will allow us to participate in the full potential of this area of the respiratory market."
Healthdyne said the Tranquility Bilevel is smaller, lighter and quieter that similar devices on the market.
